We have *Dia de Todos los Santos* (All Saints’ Day) on November 1st and *Dia de los Muertos* (Day of the Dead) on November 2nd, which are much more important. We visit family graves, decorate them with flowers, and eat traditional foods like *turrón* and *pestiños*.
Eat a huge roast turkey with all the trimmings, exchange gifts on January 6th (Epiphany), and enjoy lots of family time.
